text.text:
Here is the latest scheduled GCP networking fabric and VPC IPAM audit report from the platform agent.

*What's wrong*
The GCP networking fabric and VPC IPAM audit ran and identified 2 critical firewall issues in project `my-project`, but could not publish its findings because no GitOps repository is registered in the `platform-agent-gitops-state` ConfigMap.

*Why*
• *FirewallRule/default-allow-rdp* — `sourceRanges 0.0.0.0/0` allows `tcp:3389` (RDP) with no target restriction.
• *FirewallRule/default-allow-ssh* — `sourceRanges 0.0.0.0/0` allows `tcp:22` (SSH) with no target restriction.

*What to do*
• *Register a GitOps repository* — add one to the `platform-agent-gitops-state` ConfigMap so future audits can open a ledger issue.
